profile_text.body:
Coursera is a for-profit public company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. It trades under the ticker COUR and files under CIK 0001651562. Through coursera.org it offers online courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees, which it describes as job-ready skills and verifiable credentials delivered with universities and companies including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford.

The company sells Coursera Plus, an annual subscription it describes as giving learners unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates. Its named programs include the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the AI Essentials Specialization, the Machine Learning Specialization, the Deep Learning Specialization, the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization. Coursera positions these around fields such as AI, data science, cybersecurity, software engineering, project management, UX design, and business analysis.

Its litigation exposure is recorded in California, with 281 cases.
